Shell Asset Management Co decreased its stake in Carmax Inc (KMX) by 74.13% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Shell Asset Management Co sold 25,749 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.40% with the market. The institutional investor held 8,985 shares of the automotive aftermarket company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $576,000, down from 34,734 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Shell Asset Management Co who had been investing in Carmax Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $11.61 billion market cap company. The stock increased 2.59% or $1.64 $64.96.
